verdict.rationale: Pendo's own session replay lets you filter by account, and its data model has accounts as a first-class entity alongside visitors (accounts can be bulk-deleted via API). That gives some account-level view of behavior. However, the evidence never shows funnels, retention, or general analytics aggregated at the account or company level. Missing for 10: documented account-level funnel and retention reports, account-level aggregation in core analytics, company/account rollups of feature adoption, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a product-manager, I can analyze behavior at the account or company level, not just per user, for B2B products

citations.quote: Filter by segment, account, plan, or tagged feature.
You can use the API endpoint to delete accounts and visitors without contacting our support team.
